chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ, from Muthannā al-Ḥannāṭ, from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAjlān, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام concerning the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
O you who believe! Enter into the submission, all together, and do not follow the footsteps of Satan; indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
He عليه السلام said: 'Regarding our wilayah.'

key_terms.السِّلْمِ: submission or entering fully into the divinely commanded path
key_terms.الشَّيْطَانِ: Satan, the clear enemy who leads people away from guidance
key_terms.خُطُوَاتِ: the successive ways or traces that one follows
key_terms.عَدُوٌّ: an enemy openly opposed to the believers
key_terms.وَلَايَتِنَا: our wilayah, the authority and guardianship of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: How does Imam Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام interpret Qur'an 2:208 in relation to wilayah?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse as referring to entering fully into the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It presents the command to enter into al-silm completely as a Quranic indication of complete adherence to their divinely appointed authority.
